title: Workholding AI — Fixture/Clamp/Pallet Intelligence

units.title: 16 Workholding AI domains with Claude Opus prompts
units.details: Added 16 WORKHOLDING-AI domains: wh_chuck_selection (3-jaw/4-jaw/collet), wh_collet_selection (ER/5C/TG), wh_vise_selection (precision/double/5-axis), wh_clamp_placement (optimization), wh_clamp_force (force calculation), wh_fixture_design (custom fixtures), wh_soft_jaw (soft jaw machining), wh_vacuum_fixturing (vacuum chucks), wh_magnetic_chuck (magnetic holding), wh_zero_point (VERO-S/Erowa/3R), wh_tombstone (multi-part), wh_pallet_system (pallet pools/FMS), wh_part_support (support/damping), wh_distortion_control (distortion prevention), wh_repeatability (setup repeatability), wh_quick_change (quick-change systems)

resources_utilized.workholding_manufacturers: Schunk, Kitagawa, SMW, Kurt, Lang, Erowa, 3R
resources_utilized.fixture_types: chucks, collets, vises, clamps, vacuum, magnetic, tombstones, pallets

summary: Complete workholding AI intelligence with 16 domains covering chuck/collet/vise selection, clamp placement and force, fixture design, soft jaws, vacuum/magnetic fixturing, zero-point systems, tombstones, pallet pools, part support, distortion control, repeatability, and quick-change systems.
